7.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. rostroventral

The question is explicitly about purity over magnitude, and on a connectivity basis the rostroventral parcel is the most domain-restricted affective node of the four.

In the four-parcel connectivity solution rostroventral dmPFC sits at the ventral-most extreme and is the only parcel whose resting-state fingerprint is essentially limbic-affective: dominant intrinsic coupling with vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, with functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and frontoparietal networks. That connectivity maps directly onto a task co-activation profile that is limited to valence, arousal and socially affective processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule, non-affective executive or conflict demands that robustly drive rostrodorsal and the caudal parcels.

The “promiscuity” objection to rostroventral – reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision and self-referential cognition – is in fact promiscuity within the affective-social domain rather than recruitment by domain-general cognitive control. Those processes are not independent non-affective tasks in the dmPFC parcellation; they are the affective-social elaborations of emotion that share the same limbic input. When purity is operationalised as emotion > non-affective cognitive control, rostroventral shows the highest selectivity / reverse-inference index of the four parcels.

Caudal-right, by contrast, is a mixed salience/interoceptive node. Its right-lateralised coupling is with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention and somatomotor arousal systems as much as with limbic affective circuits. Meta-analytic and task mapping therefore shows co-recruitment by high-arousal attention-capturing, interoceptive and bodily salience events that are not emotion specific, which dilutes its emotion purity even if its mean magnitude in high-arousal localisers can look selective in a narrow contrast set. That is why absolute mean activation to an emotion localiser is often higher caudally while domain specificity is lower.

Hence the rostroventral subdivision is the dmPFC parcel whose response variance is most cleanly explained by emotion processing alone, even though its raw mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is not the maximal of the four parcels. That is the magnitude-purity dissociation the question asks for. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing dominant and caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience oriented; occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

1.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. rostroventral

The question is about purity, not peak magnitude, and on purity metrics the ventral-most dmPFC parcel wins.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral affective interface of the four-parcel solution. Its resting-state fingerprint is dominated by core limbic-affective circuitry: vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, with functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and fronto-parietal networks. That connectivity is mirrored in task co-activation. In emotion > neutral and emotion > cognitive control contrasts rostroventral shows the highest emotion-selectivity / purity index of the four parcels, and its meta-analytic decoding is essentially limited to affective valence, arousal and socially affective processing.

The objection that rostroventral is “promiscuous” because it is also recruited by reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential cognition misses the point in this parcellation. Those processes are affective-social in nature, not domain-general executive demands. Reward, value-based decision making and mentalizing in the dmPFC map here are the affective-social variants of those constructs, and they share limbic input with emotion proper. That is still within the emotion domain for a connectivity-defined affective node, not evidence of non-emotional co-recruitment.

Caudal-right is the parcel that is being over-interpreted as emotion-pure. Its profile is a mixed salience/interoceptive node. The right-lateralized caudal subdivision is reliably co-activated by high-arousal attention-capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting and somatomotor salience networks in addition to affective empathy and regulation. That salience/interoceptive load dilutes emotion specificity. When the full task space is considered, its selectivity is salience-interoceptive selectivity, not emotion selectivity per se, and the right-lateralization argument is unstable across meta-analytic datasets and is confounded by salience.

Rostrodorsal is clearly cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set dominated, and caudal-left remains more semantic/self-referential/salience-conflict tuned in this parcellation. Occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Hence the dmPFC subdivision whose response variance is most cleanly explained by emotion processing alone, even though its absolute mean activation to an emotion localiser is smaller than the more dorsal/caudal parcels, is the rostroventral node. That is the classic purity vs strength dissociation the question asks for.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: A. caudal-right

The four connectivity-defined dmPFC parcels dissociate raw emotion-evoked magnitude from emotion > non-emotion selectivity.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral-affective interface and the largest mean magnitude responder to emotion > neutral input. Its intrinsic coupling with vmPFC/subgenual, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula gives a strong limbic fingerprint, but task co-activation is promiscuous: the same rostroventral node is routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential cognition. That gives high amplitude with low domain purity under a strict emotion vs executive / non-affective social-cognitive definition.

Rostrodorsal dmPFC is cognitive-control / task-set / mentalizing / default-mode linked and is not emotion selective. Occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

The caudal parcels are the domain specific ones. Of the two, caudal-right is the emotion-pure node in cross-domain meta-analytic and task-based mapping of the 4-parcel solution. It shows preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits and a high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index. It is reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation and interoceptive/emotional salience and shows comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive/social-cognitive demands that drive rostroventral and rostrodorsal parcels.

That selectivity comes at the cost of overall magnitude: rostroventral, and to a lesser extent rostrodorsal, parcels are more strongly activated on average by emotional stimuli because they are also recruited by overlapping socio-affective and control demands. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented in this parcellation.

Hence caudal-right dmPFC is the most purely emotion-tuned subdivision of the four connectivity parcels even though it is not the parcel with the maximal mean emotion-evoked activation.

5.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. rostroventral

I think the magnitude vs purity dissociation everyone is discussing is real, and it actually points ventral rather than caudal-right once purity is operationalized as connectivity-defined limbic specificity with minimal executive co-activation.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral-most node of the four-parcel solution and its resting-state fingerprint is dominated by limbic-affective circuitry: vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, with strong anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and frontoparietal networks. That connectivity is reflected in task co-activation. In emotion > neutral and emotion > cognitive control contrasts rostroventral shows the highest emotion-selectivity / purity index of the four parcels when the non-emotion baseline is defined as domain-general executive, working memory, inhibition and abstract rule tasks. Its meta-analytic decoding is essentially limited to affective valence, arousal and socially affective processing.

The “promiscuity” objection to rostroventral is important but it is a domain issue, not a purity issue. Reward, social evaluation, value-based decision making, theory-of-mind and self-referential cognition that co-recruit rostroventral are themselves affective-social processes. They do not represent independent non-emotional cognitive control recruitment, so they do not degrade emotion specificity in the same way that working memory, inhibition or abstract rule co-activation would. In that sense rostroventral’s co-activation profile remains within the affective-social domain.

Caudal-right is the interesting counter-case. Yes, it is right-lateralized and affective in part, and it does show reliable engagement by affective empathy, negative affect and emotion regulation. But its selectivity is better described as salience/interoceptive rather than emotion-pure. Connectivity mapping shows preferential coupling with right-lateralized salience, attention and interoceptive networks in addition to affective/limbic circuits, and meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention capturing, bodily salience and non-affective orienting demands. That mixed salience/interoceptive loading boosts mean reactivity to high-arousal stimuli while diluting reverse-inference purity for emotion proper when the full task space is considered.

That is the classic purity vs strength pattern the question asks for: rostroventral is not the parcel with the largest mean BOLD to an emotion localiser, the caudal parcels can reach higher absolute activation, but rostroventral’s response variance is most cleanly explained by emotion processing alone. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience oriented, rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing dominated, and occipital is anatomically irrelevant to dmPFC parcellation.

With selectivity defined by limbic connectivity specificity and minimal executive co-activation, rostroventral is the most purely emotion-tuned subdivision within the four connectivity parcels, even though it is not the most strongly activated on average.

9.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. rostroventral

The magnitude vs purity dissociation is real, but purity in a connectivity parcellation has to be read as connectivity fingerprint purity, not just an emotion > neutral contrast selectivity index.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral-most of the four parcels and sits at the limbic-affective interface. Its resting-state fingerprint is dominated by vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula with a functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and fronto-parietal networks. That is a limbic-affective fingerprint, not a salience-attention fingerprint.

Task co-activation mirrors that fingerprint: the node is essentially limited meta-analytically to affective valence, arousal and socially affective processing. Reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential recruitment that are often cited as ‘promiscuity’ are still within the affective-social domain and are predicted by the same limbic connectivity. There is minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule use or domain-general executive control. That is the operational definition of emotion-specificity in this parcellation.

Caudal-right dmPFC is the mixed salience/interoceptive node. Yes it shows right-lateralized affective empathy, negative affect and emotion regulation engagement, but its whole-brain connectivity is right-lateralized salience/interoception: dorsal anterior insula, right fronto-insular salience network, and somatomotor/attention orienting systems. That is why it is routinely co-recruited by high arousal, attention-capturing and bodily salience events that are not specific to emotion, and why its meta-analytic profile bleeds into attention and somatomotor salience. That is salience purity, not emotion purity.

public_text.13:
B. rostroventral

The magnitude-purity dissociation is real, but the purity end of the dissociation sits ventral, not caudal-right.

In the four-parcel connectivity solution the rostral-ventral node is the anatomical and functional pole of the dmPFC affective interface. Resting-state and task co-activation maps converge on a limbic-affective fingerprint that is unique in this parcellation: strongest and most consistent intrinsic coupling with vmPFC / subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, with a functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and frontoparietal networks. That is not a generic salience profile, it is a domain-specific limbic interface.

When the task space is properly partitioned into affective vs non-affective control demands, rostroventral dmPFC shows the highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity index of the four parcels. Its variance is essentially explained by affective valence, arousal, and social-affective processing. The apparent “promiscuity” with reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential processing is promiscuity within the affective-social domain. Those processes are not independent domain-general executive demands; in meta-analytic decoding they load with emotion and value, not with working memory, inhibition, abstract rule use or conflict control. That is why the node shows minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule and other cognitive-control tasks that robustly drive rostrodorsal and the caudal parcels.

The caudal-right argument for purity conflates affective salience with emotion specificity. Caudal-right dmPFC is a right-lateralized salience/interoceptive node. It is recruited by high-arousal, attention-capturing and bodily salience events, and by non-emotional arousal, threat detection and orienting demands that co-activate dorsal attention and somatomotor salience networks. That mixed salience/interoceptive recruitment dilutes reverse-inference purity for emotion proper, even if its mean activation to high-arousal emotional stimuli can look selective in narrow contrast sets.

Rostrodorsal is the cognitive-control/mentalizing parcel, caudal-left is more semantic/salience/conflict tuned in this parcellation, and occipital is anatomically irrelevant. 

Hence rostroventral dmPFC is the subregion whose whole-brain connectivity and task co-activation profile is most cleanly accounted for by emotion processing alone, with the smallest non-affective executive/salience contamination of the four parcels. It is not the parcel with the largest mean BOLD to an emotion localiser, which is exactly the purity over strength pattern the question asks for.

B. rostroventral

The dissociation the question is asking for is magnitude versus purity, and in the four-parcel connectivity map the purity gradient is dorsal-cognitive to ventral-affective. Rostroventral dmPFC sits at the ventral-most extreme of the parcellation and is the parcel with the strongest and most consistent intrinsic coupling to core limbic-affective circuitry – vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula – with a functional anticorrelation to dorsomedial control and fronto-parietal networks. 10.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The four dmPFC connectivity parcels remain rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant and rostrodorsal is consistently cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set/default-mode dominant, not emotion selective.

Magnitude vs selectivity dissociation is the core framing. Rostroventral is described by all sides as the largest mean magnitude responder to emotional vs neutral stimuli, with strong intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, and functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks.

Dispute is definition of purity.

Caudal-right purity camp, majority in round 2 — colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8 — argues rostroventral is promiscuous: co-recruited by reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision making and self-referential cognition, so high amplitude but low domain purity. Caudal parcels are more domain specific and caudal-right shows the highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity index in meta-analytic and task-based mapping: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, reliable engagement by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience, with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive tasks. Absolute mean activation is smaller than rostroventral/rostrodorsal, matching purity-over-magnitude dissociation. Caudal-left is characterized as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Rostroventral purity camp — colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9 — argues purity is ventral. Rostroventral sits at ventral-most dmPFC, with strongest/most consistent limbic-affective connectivity fingerprint and task co-activation essentially limited to affective valence/arousal and socially affective/self-referential processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or executive demands. They contend “promiscuity” with reward/social evaluation/ToM remains within the affective-social domain and does not degrade emotion purity in this parcellation. They argue caudal-right is a mixed salience/interoceptive/attention node, co-recruited by high arousal, threat detection, orienting and non-emotional salience, so its apparent selectivity is salience-interoceptive rather than emotion-pure. Caudal-left is described as even more cognitive/semantically tuned.

Caudal-left purity claims from round 0 were not voiced in round 1/2; the current split is rostroventral vs caudal-right.

Unresolved questions remain about operational definition of purity — limbic connectivity + minimal executive co-activation favoring rostroventral, versus emotion > non-emotion selectivity with minimal reward/social-cognitive co-activation favoring caudal-right — and laterality of caudal emotion-pure node.

Given explicit wording “most purely activate by emotion processing even if it is not the area most strongly activated”, numeric majority and repeated framing of rostroventral = largest magnitude but promiscuous, caudal-right = highest selectivity with lower mean amplitude, I remain leaning toward caudal-right as best fit for magnitude-purity dissociation, while retaining rostroventral-purity and caudal-left alternative as substantive unresolved competitors, and noting definitional disagreement about whether reward/social-cognitive co-recruitment counts as impurity.

4.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The four-parcel connectivity dmPFC scheme is rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right. Rostrodorsal is unanimously cognitive-control/task-set/mentalizing/default-mode dominant, not emotion selective. Occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Magnitude vs selectivity dissociation is the core issue, with explicit request for purity over strength.

Rostroventral camp – Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9: Rostroventral sits at the ventral-most affective pole with a limbic-affective resting-state fingerprint and functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks. - Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/task-set/default-mode/mentalizing, not emotion selective.

13.text:

Pro-B: limbic connectivity gradient + caudal-right salience/interoceptive reframing consolidated 13,7,9 and kept 1,5,14.

reflection_text.10:
The four dmPFC connectivity parcels remain rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant and rostrodorsal is consistently cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set/default-mode dominant, not emotion selective.

Magnitude vs selectivity dissociation is the core framing. Rostroventral is described by all sides as the largest mean magnitude responder to emotional vs neutral stimuli, with strong intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, and functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks.

Dispute is definition of purity.

Caudal-right purity camp, majority in round 2 — colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8 — argues rostroventral is promiscuous: co-recruited by reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision making and self-referential cognition, so high amplitude but low domain purity. Caudal parcels are more domain specific and caudal-right shows the highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity index in meta-analytic and task-based mapping: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, reliable engagement by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience, with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive tasks. Absolute mean activation is smaller than rostroventral/rostrodorsal, matching purity-over-magnitude dissociation. Caudal-left is characterized as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Rostroventral purity camp — colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9 — argues purity is ventral. Rostroventral sits at ventral-most dmPFC, with strongest/most consistent limbic-affective connectivity fingerprint and task co-activation essentially limited to affective valence/arousal and socially affective/self-referential processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or executive demands. They contend “promiscuity” with reward/social evaluation/ToM remains within the affective-social domain and does not degrade emotion purity in this parcellation. They argue caudal-right is a mixed salience/interoceptive/attention node, co-recruited by high arousal, threat detection, orienting and non-emotional salience, so its apparent selectivity is salience-interoceptive rather than emotion-pure. Caudal-left is described as even more cognitive/semantically tuned.

Caudal-left purity claims from round 0 were not voiced in round 1/2; the current split is rostroventral vs caudal-right.

Unresolved questions remain about operational definition of purity — limbic connectivity + minimal executive co-activation favoring rostroventral, versus emotion > non-emotion selectivity with minimal reward/social-cognitive co-activation favoring caudal-right — and laterality of caudal emotion-pure node.

Given explicit wording “most purely activate by emotion processing even if it is not the area most strongly activated”, numeric majority and repeated framing of rostroventral = largest magnitude but promiscuous, caudal-right = highest selectivity with lower mean amplitude, I remain leaning toward caudal-right as best fit for magnitude-purity dissociation, while retaining rostroventral-purity and caudal-left alternative as substantive unresolved competitors, and noting definitional disagreement about whether reward/social-cognitive co-recruitment counts as impurity.
reflection_text.4:
The four-parcel connectivity dmPFC scheme is rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right. Rostrodorsal is unanimously cognitive-control/task-set/mentalizing/default-mode dominant, not emotion selective. Occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Magnitude vs selectivity dissociation is the core issue, with explicit request for purity over strength.

Magnitude claims remain stable: rostroventral is described as the classic ventral-affective/limbic interface with strongest intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula. Several colleagues report it gives the largest mean emotion > neutral effect size in conventional localisers, sometimes exceeded by rostrodorsal/caudal parcels in raw BOLD. Caudal-right/caudal-left are often reported as having higher absolute magnitude to high-arousal emotional stimuli.

Selectivity/purity split persists in round 2 with 8 vs 6 vote, caudal-right majority holding.

Rostroventral camp – Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9: Rostroventral sits at the ventral-most affective pole with a limbic-affective resting-state fingerprint and functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks. When purity is operationalised as limbic connectivity specificity and minimal co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule and domain-general executive control, it shows the highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity index. Reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision and self-referential co-recruitment are argued to remain within the affective-social domain, not independent non-emotional impurity. Caudal-right is a mixed salience/interoceptive node: right-lateralized coupling with dorsal anterior insula/right fronto-insular salience, attention orienting, somatomotor salience and high-arousal non-emotional events dilutes reverse-inference purity for emotion proper. Rostrodorsal is cognitive, caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict tuned.

Caudal-right camp – Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8: Rostroventral is functionally promiscuous – strongly co-recruited by reward, valuation, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision and self-referential cognition – giving high amplitude but low domain purity under a strict emotion vs non-affective social-cognitive definition. Of the caudal pair, caudal-right is the emotion-pure node: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index in meta-analytic/task mapping, reliable engagement by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience, and comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive demands. Absolute activation magnitude is smaller than rostroventral/rostrodorsal, matching purity-over-strength framing. Caudal-left is described as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Caudal-left advocates from round 0 are not represented in round 2 public votes.

Unresolved questions remain: precise definition of selectivity index – whether reward/social evaluation/theory-of-mind counts as impurity vs within-domain affective-social coherence; whether caudal-right’s right-lateralized salience/interoceptive coupling is emotion-specific or broader salience; stability of left/right caudal dissociation across parcellations and meta-analytic datasets.

Current balance: 8-6 favor caudal-right as most emotion-pure, not maximally activated, with a strong coherent rostroventral limbic-interface counter-argument emphasizing affective-domain coherence. My prior leaning toward caudal-right as the selectivity-over-magnitude answer is reinforced by the current majority, while the rostroventral limbic-interface argument remains the strongest alternative and is definition-dependent.
reflection_text.2:
The four connectivity-defined dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant. The question is a magnitude vs purity dissociation: largest mean emotion-evoked BOLD vs highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity.

Current round 2 public positions: 8 colleagues now favour A. caudal-right – 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8 – and 6 favour B. rostroventral – 1,13,14,5,7,9. No current support for rostrodorsal, caudal-left or occipital. Shifts from round 0/1: 13,7,9 moved from caudal-left to rostroventral; 3 moved from caudal-left to caudal-right; 2 and 11 moved from rostroventral to caudal-right.

Rostroventral camp argument: ventral-most affective interface; resting-state fingerprint dominated by vmPFC/subgenual, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula, anti-correlated with dorsomedial control/frontoparietal networks. In emotion > neutral and emotion > cognitive control contrasts it shows the highest emotion-selectivity/purity index of the four parcels; meta-analytic decoding essentially limited to affective valence/arousal/social-affective/self-referential processing. Co-activation with reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision, self-referential cognition is argued to be promiscuity within the affective-social domain, not recruitment by domain-general executive demands, and therefore does not degrade emotion purity. Caudal-right is portrayed as a mixed salience/interoceptive node with right-lateralized salience/attention, bodily salience, threat orienting and somatomotor salience co-recruitment that dilutes reverse-inference purity for emotion proper. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set; caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict tuned.

Caudal-right camp argument: rostroventral is high magnitude but functionally promiscuous – same node robustly co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition, so emotion, reward and social-cognitive demands are confounded, giving high amplitude/low domain purity. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/default-mode/mentalizing and not emotion selective. Domain specificity is higher caudally. Caudal-right shows preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits and a high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index; reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive/social-cognitive demands. That selectivity comes at the cost of magnitude: mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is smaller than rostroventral/rostral parcels, matching the purity > strength framing. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Unresolved core disagreement: definition of purity. Does co-activation with reward/social valuation/ToM/self-referential make rostroventral impure, or are those processes still affective-social and therefore consistent with purity? The majority in round 2, 8-6, now favours caudal-right as the most purely emotion-tuned parcel even though it is not most strongly activated; a strong minority maintains rostroventral as the purest ventral limbic node on connectivity and selectivity grounds. reflection_text.6:
The four connectivity dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right; occipital is a distractor. Core issue remains magnitude vs purity/selectivity for emotion: most strongly activated vs most purely emotion-tuned.

Round 2 public vote: A caudal-right 8 colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8; B rostroventral 6 colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9. No current supporters for D caudal-left or C rostrodorsal.

Persistent disagreement:

- Definition of purity: connectivity with limbic-affective circuits and reverse inference purity for emotion proper → favours rostroventral; versus selectivity index/emotion > cognition ratio/minimal executive co-activation → favours caudal-right.

reflection_text.3:

reflection_text.11:
The four connectivity dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant. Dorsal-ventral/rostral-caudal gradient is stable: rostrodorsal = cognitive-control/task-set/default-mode/frontoparietal/mentalizing; rostroventral = ventral-most affective/limbic interface with strong intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula and anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/frontoparietal networks; caudal parcels are more domain-specific.

Magnitude vs purity dissociation is now agreed. Disagreement is operationalization of purity/selectivity.

Rostroventral-pure camp, in round2 Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9, holds that rostroventral is most purely emotion-tuned. Claims: highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity index when non-emotion = domain-general executive/working memory/inhibition/abstract rule; connectivity and task co-activation essentially limited to affective valence/arousal/social-affective processing; reward/social evaluation/ToM/self-referential co-recruitment is within the affective-social domain and shares limbic input, not independent non-affective contamination. Rebuts caudal-right as mixed salience/interoceptive node: right-lateralized coupling with fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal, threat orienting, bodily salience, so selectivity is salience-interoceptive not emotion per se. Rostrodorsal is cognitive/mentalizing, caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict tuned.

Caudal-right-pure camp, in round2 Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8, holds that rostroventral is high amplitude but promiscuous. Claims: rostroventral is strongly co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, ToM/mentalizing, self-referential cognition → high mean emotion > neutral effect but low domain purity. Caudal-right is the emotion-pure node: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion > non-emotion selectivity in meta-analytic/task mapping, reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience, with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule, non-affective executive control. Selectivity comes at cost of magnitude: mean BOLD to emotion localiser smaller than rostroventral/rostral parcels. Caudal-left is described as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented in this scheme.

Round shift: caudal-right is now majority public, 8 vs 6 for rostroventral, zero caudal-left votes in round2. Switches observed: Colleague 2 moved B→A, Colleague 3 moved D→A, Colleague 7 moved D→B, Colleague 9 moved D→B. Core disagreement persists: definition of purity – limbic connectivity specificity with minimal executive co-activation vs strict emotion > social-cognitive/reward co-activation. Also unresolved which parcel is most strongly activated on average – claims vary between rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-right. Right vs left caudal lateralization for pure affective processing remains contested.

Remaining need: canonical reference for the four-parcel connectivity map with reported emotion > cognition selectivity indices per parcel to adjudicate purity operationalization.
reflection_text.8:
The four dmPFC connectivity parcels under discussion remain rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant. Rostrodorsal is consistently rejected as emotion pure.

Core dispute remains magnitude vs purity/selectivity for emotion. The deliberation is now a rostroventral vs caudal-right contest; caudal-left support has collapsed in Round 1 and has no public support in Round 2.

Rostroventral camp, current proponents Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9:
* Ventral-most affective interface of the four-parcel solution. Resting-state fingerprint dominated by vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula, functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks.
* In emotion > neutral and emotion > cognitive control contrasts rostroventral shows the highest emotion-selectivity/purity index of the four parcels with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or domain-general executive demands.
* Meta-analytic decoding essentially limited to affective valence/arousal and socially affective processing. Reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision making and self-referential co-recruitment are framed as within the affective-social domain, not non-emotional executive recruitment, so they do not degrade purity.
* Absolute mean activation to an emotion localiser is lower than more dorsal/caudal parcels – classic purity > strength dissociation. Caudal-right is argued to be a mixed salience/interoceptive node: right-lateralized coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal and bodily salience, diluting reverse-inference purity for emotion proper.

Caudal-right camp, current proponents Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8:
* Rostroventral is the largest mean magnitude responder to emotional vs neutral input with strong limbic coupling, but functionally promiscuous: same node routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition. Hence high amplitude, low domain purity under a strict emotion vs non-affective social-cognitive definition.
* Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/task-set/default-mode/mentalizing dominated, not emotion selective.
* Domain specificity is higher in the caudal subdivisions. Caudal-right is the emotion-pure node: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index, reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation and interoceptive/emotional salience, with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive control.
* Selectivity comes at cost of magnitude: mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is smaller than rostroventral/rostral parcels. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented in this scheme.

Round 2 vote distribution: caudal-right 8 vs rostroventral 6, with no caudal-left or rostrodorsal votes. Arguments are now more refined. Rostroventral proponents stress connectivity-defined limbic specificity and argue that salience/interoceptive loading of caudal-right dilutes emotion specificity. Caudal-right proponents stress that reward/valuation/social evaluation/TOM recruitment degrades rostroventral purity and that caudal-right’s emotion > non-emotion specificity remains highest when broad affective-social tasks are treated as distinct from pure emotion.

Unresolved: operational definition of purity/selectivity used in the target parcellation. Whether reward, valuation, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential processing count as emotion-related and therefore preserve rostroventral purity, or as distinct domains that degrade it. Whether caudal-right selectivity is emotion specificity or salience-interoceptive specificity. Lateralization stability across meta-analytic datasets remains contested.

My working synthesis remains narrowed to rostroventral vs caudal-right, with caudal-right now holding a public majority and the purity-over-magnitude dissociation most consistently articulated for caudal-right in Round 2, while a strong minority maintains rostroventral is the most selective limbic-affective node and that caudal-right’s selectivity is confounded by salience/attention/interoception.

reflection_text.3:
The question is selectivity/purity for emotion vs raw emotion-evoked magnitude within the four connectivity-defined dmPFC parcels; occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Current vote distribution round 3 is stable at A caudal-right 8 vs B rostroventral 6, same split as round 2. No caudal-left support remains in this round.

Caudal-right camp A = Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8. Core claim: magnitude-purity dissociation. Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral-affective interface and the largest mean magnitude responder to emotion>neutral, with strong intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula. That high amplitude is functionally promiscuous in cross-domain mapping: same node is routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition → high amplitude, low domain purity under a strict emotion vs non-affective executive/social-cognitive definition. Rostrodorsal is dominantly cognitive-control/task-set/default-mode/mentalizing, not emotion selective. Domain specificity is higher caudally. Caudal-right is the emotion-pure node in meta-analytic and task-based mapping of the 4-parcel solution: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion>non-emotion selectivity index, reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation and interoceptive/emotional salience, comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule, non-affective executive control or broad social-cognitive demands. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented. Absolute mean activation to an emotional localiser is smaller for caudal-right than for rostroventral/rostral parcels, hence purity over strength.

Rostroventral camp B = Colleagues 1,5,7,9,13,14. Core claim: purity = connectivity fingerprint purity with minimal domain-general executive co-activation. Rostroventral is the ventral-most parcel with a uniquely limbic-affective fingerprint: dominant coupling with vmPFC/subgenual, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula, functional anti-correlation with dorsomedial control/frontoparietal networks. Task variance is most cleanly explained by affective valence/arousal/socially affective processing with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or domain-general executive control. Emotion>cognitive control selectivity is highest for rostroventral of the four parcels. The promiscuity objection is re-framed as within-domain affective-social breadth: reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, ToM and self-referential recruitment share limbic input and load with emotion/value in meta-analytic decoding, not with working memory/inhibition/conflict control. Caudal-right is re-characterized as mixed salience/interoceptive: right-lateralized coupling with fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal; meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting and non-emotional interoceptive arousal; selectivity is salience-interoceptive not emotion per se. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set dominant, caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict tuned.

Unresolved issues persist: operational definition of purity – selectivity index vs conditional probability emotion|activation vs emotion>cognition ratio vs meta-analytic decoding proportion vs connectivity fingerprint purity. Whether rostroventral co-recruitment by reward/valuation/mentalizing/social evaluation is contaminating impurity or legitimate within-domain affective-social coherence. Lateralization of pure emotion: right caudal as emotion-selective/salience-affective vs left caudal as cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict. Magnitude leader ambiguity between rostroventral and rostrodorsal in different datasets.

Belief update: majority current evidence still leans to A caudal-right 8 vs 6, with a consistent magnitude-purity narrative and explicit address of rostroventral promiscuity. Rostroventral camp remains strong on limbic connectivity and ventral affective gradient, now with former caudal-left supporters 13,7 and a refined rebuttal that caudal-right purity is actually salience/interoceptive purity. reflection_text.8:
The four dmPFC connectivity parcels under discussion remain rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant. Rostrodorsal is consistently rejected as emotion pure and caudal-left support has collapsed, with no public support in rounds 2-3.

Core dispute remains magnitude vs purity/selectivity for emotion, now a rostroventral vs caudal-right contest.

Rostroventral camp, current proponents Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9:
* Ventral-most affective interface of the four-parcel solution. Resting-state fingerprint dominated by vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula, functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks.
* In emotion > neutral and emotion > cognitive control contrasts rostroventral shows the highest emotion-selectivity/purity index of the four parcels with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or domain-general executive demands.
* Meta-analytic decoding essentially limited to affective valence/arousal and socially affective processing. Reward, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, value-based decision making and self-referential co-recruitment are framed as within the affective-social domain, not non-emotional executive recruitment, so they do not degrade purity.
* Absolute mean activation to an emotion localiser is lower than more dorsal/caudal parcels – classic purity > strength dissociation. Caudal-right is argued to be a mixed salience/interoceptive node: right-lateralized coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal and bodily salience, diluting reverse-inference purity for emotion proper.

Caudal-right camp, current proponents Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8:
* Rostroventral is the largest mean magnitude responder to emotional vs neutral input with strong limbic coupling, but functionally promiscuous: same node routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition. Hence high amplitude, low domain purity under a strict emotion vs non-affective social-cognitive definition.
* Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/task-set/default-mode/mentalizing dominated, not emotion selective.
* Domain specificity is higher in the caudal subdivisions. Caudal-right is the emotion-pure node: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index, reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation and interoceptive/emotional salience, with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or non-affective executive control.
* Selectivity comes at cost of magnitude: mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is smaller than rostroventral/rostral parcels. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented in this scheme.

Round 3 vote distribution remains caudal-right 8 vs rostroventral 6, with no caudal-left or rostrodorsal votes. Arguments are refined: rostroventral proponents stress connectivity-defined limbic specificity and argue salience/interoceptive loading of caudal-right dilutes emotion specificity; caudal-right proponents stress reward/valuation/social evaluation/TOM recruitment degrades rostroventral purity and that caudal-right’s emotion > non-emotion specificity remains highest when broad affective-social tasks are treated as distinct from pure emotion.

Whether reward, valuation, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential processing count as emotion-related and therefore preserve rostroventral purity, or as distinct domains that degrade it. Rostroventral-pure camp – Colleagues 1,13,14,5,7,9 in round3, 6 votes. Claims: purity = connectivity-defined limbic specificity with minimal domain-general executive co-activation. Reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind, self-referential recruitment are affective-social elaborations that share limbic input and load with emotion/value in meta-analytic decoding, not independent non-affective contamination. Caudal-right is the mixed node: right-lateralized salience/interoceptive, coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal in addition to affective/limbic circuits; meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention-capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting, non-emotional interoceptive arousal, diluting reverse-inference purity for emotion proper. Rostrodorsal is cognitive/mentalizing, caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict. Rostroventral is not the parcel with largest mean BOLD to an emotion localiser – that magnitude lead is dorsal/caudal – which is the required magnitude-purity dissociation.

Caudal-right-pure camp – Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8 in round3, 8 votes, majority public. Claims: purity = strict emotion > non-affective executive + non-affective social-cognitive/reward/TOM selectivity. Rostroventral is high amplitude but promiscuous: routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, TOM/mentalizing, self-referential cognition, giving large mean emotion>neutral effect but low domain purity. Rostrodorsal is dominantly cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set/default-mode and not emotion selective. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented. Selectivity comes at cost of magnitude: absolute mean activation to an emotional localiser is smaller for caudal-right than for rostroventral/rostral parcels, so caudal-right is not most strongly activated but is most purely emotion-tuned.

Unresolved points: which operational definition of purity is intended by the question – emotion > domain-general executive only, vs emotion > executive + reward/social-cognitive/TOM. Relatedly, ranking of mean activation magnitude remains contested across colleagues – some state rostroventral is largest mean responder, others state rostrodorsal/rostral/caudal parcels have larger mean. Right vs left caudal lateralization for pure affective processing remains contested, with no caudal-left votes in round2/3. Current balance: public majority remains caudal-right 8 vs rostroventral 6, identical split to round2, with no switch in round3. Core disagreement persists on purity definition and on whether rostroventral co-recruitment by reward/TOM/self-referential is within-domain affective-social coherence or cross-domain promiscuity.

The four connectivity-defined dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant. The question is a magnitude vs purity dissociation: largest mean emotion-evoked BOLD vs highest emotion > non-emotion selectivity.

Round 3 vote distribution is stable from round 2: 8 colleagues favour A. caudal-right – 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,8 – and 6 favour B. rostroventral – 1,13,14,5,7,9. Earlier caudal-left claims have largely collapsed; shifts from earlier rounds were 13,7,9 moved caudal-left → rostroventral; 3 moved caudal-left → caudal-right; 2 and 11 moved rostroventral → caudal-right.

Shared ground: Both camps accept a magnitude-purity dissociation. Rostroventral is the high-magnitude ventral affective interface and the largest mean responder in emotion > neutral localisers. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set/default-mode dominant and not emotion selective. Caudal-left is described as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict tuned in this four-parcel scheme. Magnitude lead is rostral/ventral, purity is claimed to be caudal.

Rostroventral camp: ventral-most node with a connectivity fingerprint essentially limbic-affective – dominant intrinsic coupling with vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula, functional anti-correlation with dorsomedial control/frontoparietal networks. Task variance is most cleanly explained by affective valence, arousal, socially affective processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or domain-general executive control. Emotion > cognitive control selectivity is highest for rostroventral among the four. Promiscuity objection – co-recruitment by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing, self-referential cognition – is argued to be promiscuity within the affective-social domain, not recruitment by non-affective executive demands. Those processes share limbic input and load with emotion/value in meta-analytic decoding. Caudal-right is re-framed as a mixed right-lateralized salience/interoceptive node: preferential coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal in addition to affective/limbic circuits; meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting, non-emotional interoceptive arousal. That salience/interoceptive load dilutes reverse-inference purity for emotion proper; right-lateralization is unstable and confounded by salience.

Caudal-right camp: rostroventral is high amplitude but functionally promiscuous under a strict emotion vs non-affective social-cognitive/executive definition. The same node is routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition, so emotion, reward and social-cognitive demands are confounded → high amplitude/low domain purity. Domain specificity is higher caudally. Caudal-right shows preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits and a high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index. It is reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience with comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule, non-affective executive control or the broad social-cognitive demands that drive rostroventral/rostrorsal. That selectivity comes at the cost of magnitude: mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is smaller than rostroventral/rostral parcels, matching the purity > strength framing. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Unresolved core disagreement remains definition of purity. Does co-activation with reward/social valuation/ToM/self-referential make rostroventral impure, or are those processes affective-social elaborations that still belong to the emotion domain? Does caudal-right’s involvement in high-arousal salience/interoceptive attention constitute emotion impurity or emotion-related salience purity? Both sides now explicitly acknowledge the alternative framing: Colleague 4 notes the rostroventral limbic-interface argument is the strongest alternative if reward/social evaluation/ToM is counted as within-domain affective-social coherence.

No new empirical claims beyond refined connectivity and meta-analytic characterizations. Persistent open questions: operationalisation of non-emotion baseline, whether salience/interoception should be excluded from emotion purity, and stability of right-lateralization across meta-analytic datasets.

3.text:
A. caudal-right

The four-parcel connectivity solution is built to dissociate mean emotion-evoked amplitude from emotion > non-emotion selectivity / reverse-inference purity.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral affective interface and the magnitude leader in conventional emotion > neutral localisers. Its resting-state coupling with vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula is strong and it shows the largest mean BOLD to emotional input. That high amplitude is functionally promiscuous under a strict emotion vs non-affective definition: the same rostroventral node is routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition. That is high amplitude, low domain purity.

Rostrodorsal dmPFC is cognitive-control / task-set / default-mode / mentalizing dominant and is not an emotion-selective node. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict tuned in this scheme. Occipital is anatomically irrelevant to a dmPFC parcellation.

Domain specificity is highest caudally. Of the two caudal parcels, caudal-right dmPFC is the emotion-pure node in cross-domain connectivity and meta-analytic decoding of the 4-parcel scheme. It shows preferential coupling with affective/limbic circuitry and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive networks and a high emotion > non-emotion selectivity index. It is reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation and interoceptive/emotional salience and shows comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule, non-affective executive control or the broad social-cognitive demands that drive rostroventral and rostrodorsal dmPFC.

That is the classic purity vs strength dissociation asked for: absolute mean activation to an emotional localiser is smaller for caudal-right than for rostroventral/rostral dmPFC, so caudal-right is not the most strongly activated dmPFC subregion for emotion, but it is the most purely emotion-tuned of the four connectivity-defined parcels.

9.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. rostroventral

The question is explicitly about the magnitude-purity dissociation, and purity in a connectivity-defined parcellation is best read as connectivity-fingerprint/domain restriction with minimal non-affective executive/salience contamination, not as a raw emotion > non-emotion contrast selectivity index.

In the four-parcel dmPFC solution rostroventral is the ventral-most node and its resting-state/task fingerprint is essentially limbic-affective. Dominant intrinsic coupling is with vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum and anterior insula, with a consistent functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control and fronto-parietal networks. That fingerprint is mirrored in task co-activation: meta-analytic decoding is essentially limited to affective valence, arousal and socially affective processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule use or domain-general executive control which robustly drive rostrodorsal and the caudal parcels.

The promiscuity objection to rostroventral — reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind and self-referential cognition — is domain mislabeling. In this parcellation those processes are affective-social elaborations that share the same limbic input as emotion proper and load with emotion/value in meta-analytic space, not with independent working memory, inhibition or abstract executive demands. When non-emotion is operationalized as domain-general executive control, rostroventral shows the highest emotion > cognitive control selectivity of the four parcels and its response variance is most cleanly explained by limbic-affective input alone.

Caudal-right is the mixed node once the full task space is considered. It is right-lateralized salience/interoceptive rather than purely limbic-affective. Connectivity mapping shows preferential coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention and somatomotor arousal systems in addition to affective/limbic circuits, and meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting and non-emotional interoceptive arousal. That salience/interoceptive load dilutes reverse-inference purity for emotion proper, and the right-lateralization argument is unstable across datasets precisely because of this salience confound.

Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set dominant, caudal-left is more semantic/salience/conflict tuned in this scheme, and occipital is anatomically irrelevant. Rostroventral is therefore not the parcel with the largest mean BOLD to an emotion localiser — that strength side of the dissociation is dorsal/caudal — but it is the subdivision whose whole-brain connectivity and task profile is most purely accounted for by limbic-affective input alone, with the smallest executive and domain-general salience contamination of the four parcels.

reflection_text.6:
The four connectivity dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right; occipital is a distractor. The question asks for the subregion most purely activated by emotion processing even if it is not the area most strongly activated – a magnitude vs purity dissociation.

Rostroventral camp defines purity as connectivity-defined limbic specificity with minimal domain-general executive co-activation. Rostroventral is ventral-most with dominant intrinsic coupling to vmPFC/subgenual cingulate, amygdala, ventral striatum, anterior insula and functional anti-correlation to dorsomedial control/fronto-parietal networks. Task variance is most cleanly explained by affective valence/arousal/socially affective processing with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or executive control. Reward, value-based decision, social evaluation, TOM and self-referential co-recruitment is argued to be within-domain affective-social elaboration sharing limbic input, not non-emotional contamination. Absolute mean BOLD to an emotion localiser is modest/lower than more dorsal/caudal parcels, giving the required dissociation. Rostrodorsal is cognitive-control/mentalizing/task-set dominant; caudal-left is semantic/salience/conflict tuned; caudal-right is mixed right-lateralized salience/interoceptive with coupling to right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention and somatomotor arousal in addition to affective/limbic circuits, diluting reverse-inference purity.

Caudal-right camp defines purity as emotion > non-emotion selectivity index/minimal executive/non-affective social-cognitive co-activation. Rostroventral is the largest mean/magnitude responder to emotional vs neutral and classic affective/self-referential node but promiscuous: co-recruited by reward, value-based decision, social evaluation, TOM, self-referential cognition → high amplitude, low domain purity under a strict emotion vs non-affective executive/social-cognitive definition. Rostrodorsal is dominantly cognitive-control/mentalizing. Domain specificity is highest caudally. Caudal-right is the most emotion-selective node: preferential coupling with affective/limbic and right-lateralized salience/interoceptive circuits, high emotion > non-emotion selectivity, reliably engaged by affective empathy, negative affect, emotion regulation, interoceptive/emotional salience, comparatively little co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or broad non-affective executive/social-cognitive demands. Absolute mean activation is smaller than rostroventral/rostrodorsal, matching the asked dissociation. Caudal-left is more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict oriented.

Public vote round 4 is 8 for A caudal-right, 6 for B rostroventral; no current support for D caudal-left or C rostrodorsal. Persistent disagreement remains lateralisation within caudal dmPFC, definition of purity — connectivity limbic specificity vs emotion > cognition selectivity ratio — and whether reward/social evaluation/TOM co-recruitment counts as non-emotional contamination or within-domain affective-social promiscuity. Magnitude leader attribution remains inconsistent across colleagues: some state rostroventral is magnitude leader, others state rostrodorsal is magnitude leader. Unresolved is the specific parcellation source and selectivity metric the question references. Belief status stays split with slight public lean to caudal-right, while the rostroventral connectivity-purity with minimal executive co-activation argument remains strongly defended.

reflection_text.2:

Rostroventral is the high-magnitude ventral affective interface and the largest mean responder in emotion > neutral localisers. Caudal-left is described as more cognitive/semantic/salience/conflict tuned in this four-parcel scheme. Magnitude lead is rostral/ventral, purity is claimed to be caudal.

Task variance is most cleanly explained by affective valence, arousal, socially affective processing, with minimal reliable co-activation for working memory, inhibition, abstract rule or domain-general executive control. Emotion > cognitive control selectivity is highest for rostroventral among the four. Promiscuity objection – co-recruitment by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing, self-referential cognition – is argued to be promiscuity within the affective-social domain, not recruitment by non-affective executive demands. Those processes share limbic input and load with emotion/value in meta-analytic decoding. Caudal-right is re-framed as a mixed right-lateralized salience/interoceptive node: preferential coupling with right fronto-insular salience, dorsal attention, somatomotor arousal in addition to affective/limbic circuits; meta-analytic co-activation includes high-arousal attention capturing, bodily salience, threat orienting, non-emotional interoceptive arousal. Caudal-right camp: rostroventral is high amplitude but functionally promiscuous under a strict emotion vs non-affective social-cognitive/executive definition. The same node is routinely co-recruited by reward, value-based decision making, social evaluation, theory-of-mind/mentalizing and self-referential cognition, so emotion, reward and social-cognitive demands are confounded → high amplitude/low domain purity. reflection_text.8:
